notes.title: The big update is out!
notes.content:
The shiny new update for Collapsed is out now! It brings improvement to the character movement, melee combat, controls and more. Please let us know your thoughts in the comments.

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h1]Character movement:[/h1]
[list]
[*] General movement improvements.
[*] Increased movement speed.
[*] No more stun when hit.
[*] Wall auto-stick is turned off by default.
[*] Wall quick jumps added.
[*] Improved character interaction on platforms’ edges.
[*] Now you can control the character’s jump distance.
[*] Improved movement when mid-air.
[*] Now you can walk through enemies.
[/list]

[h1]Melee combat:[/h1]
[list]
[*] General melee combat improvements.
[*] Now dashing interrupts melee attacks and other character’s actions.
[*] Increased melee attacks speed.
[*] Increased melee attacks range.
[/list]

[h1]Other:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved gamepad controls.
[*] Now there is only one item grade.
[*] Reworked difficulty balance.
[*] A lot of bug-fixes.
[/list]

And we’ve already started working on the next update – it will bring a rebalanced item grade system. Stay tuned and thanks for your patience and feedback!

notes.title: 08.08.19 Patch notes
notes.content:
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed achievements are not earned after restart
[*]"Force Blade" item fix
[*]Fixed items count in the popup messages
[*]Fixed lock caused by a red portal
[*]Fixed pausing after Steam overlay is opened
[*]Fixed crash if you pressed wear & drop an item at the same time
[*]Supreme Slaver fix
[*]Supreme Seedcore fix
[*]Fixed crash if you take damage while "Fire Suffering Module" is on
[*]Fixed item loss in inventory
[*]Fixed bullet freezing in coop gameplay
[*]Fixed level generator, causing game lock at the start of the level
[/list]

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
[list]
[*]FPS drops after a long play session
[*]Problems with enemies with hook
[*]Coop sync bug of "Medbot Module" item
[/list]


Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: 08.05.19 Patch notes
notes.content:
Hi!

This update fixes:

-GPU loading at 100% with V-Sync turned off.

Now the graphics cards (especially the more powerful ones) will not be loaded at 100%.

Thank you all for your comments and reviews!
Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Collapsed: Future updates
notes.content:
[h1]Hunters![/h1]

First of all, we would like to thank you for playing our game, giving valuable feedback, notifying us of all kinds of errors and bugs, and helping us to improve the game in every way!
We greatly appreciate your support!
Thanks you!

[h1]Now a little about future updates to the game[/h1]

1. We are preparing a big update for melee based on your feedback. In this update, Hunters will be able to aim with melee weapons, like ranged weapons. It will also become possible to interrupt attacks using a dash or jump.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35080310/8c2706e9a3a28dd535a87e5e0c7c7a6670f94c61.jpg[/img]

2. We are working on an improved character movement system to make it more flexible and responsive.

3. Work on features of the category "quality for life", which simply brings convenience to the UI and other aspects of the game.

4. And finally - we are working on fixing bugs so that the game does not produce unexpected "surprises".

We are also thinking about adding a free DLC, in the form of a hardcore rogue-LIKE mode, with a complete loss of loot and another progression curve in the game.

[h1]Thank you for playing the game![/h1]

P.S. Come to our discord group to discuss the game, find a partner for co-op, and just for chatting :) https://discordapp.com/invite/46CYN6k
